title: Natural geometric comparison of explicit residue homology quotients
statement: Let f:X -> S and fi:Xi -> S be flat proper locally finitely presented, ui:Xi -> X over S, L invertible, k:W -> S an immersion, w in affine U, and s=k(w). Supply a trivialization tau of L on X_s and strictly perfect representatives K,Ci of the restricted direct images. No connectivity, target differential vanishing, or separate target trivialization hypothesis is needed for this homology-level comparison. Supply a prime ideal p of Gamma(W,U) together with hp:p=ker(Gamma(W,U) -> kappa(w)), and construct H(K),H(Ci) as the actual residue cycles modulo boundaries [lem-sc-affine-residue-cycle-class-quotient]. There exist additive equivalences eK:H(K) -> H1(X_s,O), eCi:H(Ci) -> H1(Xi_s,O), and derived arrows ai:Q(K) -> Q(Ci), such that for every phi with Q(phi)=ai and every z in H(K), eCi(H(phi)(z))=ui_s^*(eK(z)), using the constructed homology map [lem-sc-affine-residue-cycle-homology-map]. This is only the geometric identification and its naturality, with no cycle-map surjectivity or kernel assertion. The geometric objects are as in [def-pc-base-change], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pc-derived-direct-image], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-perfect-complex], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback], [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-weil-residue-field].
